title: Fixed timeline, duplicate ages, and personal chronology

characters.name: Lena Ortiz
characters.goals: Complete the event she witnessed as a child
characters.fears: Mistaking calendar order for personal order

finding.title: The same elder Lena returns alive after her one-way trip and recorded death
finding.summary: The fixed timeline sends Elder Lena one way to 1988, where her identified body is recorded dead, but that exact traveler later walks into the lab in 2049.
finding.question: Can the same Elder Lena return alive in 2049 under the one-way fixed-timeline rules and her recorded death?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Elder Lena dies in 1988 and the coroner records her unique wrist serial.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: The same traveler with that wrist serial walks into the lab alive in 2049 despite the one-way gate.
finding.inference_explanation: The surviving child Lena explains the later 2048 departure, but it does not explain the dead traveler's personal return after that departure.

evidence.quote: Elder Lena dies at 3:14 a.m. The coroner records her wrist serial: L-2048-77.
The same Elder Lena, identified by wrist serial L-2048-77, walks into the lab alive on January 1, 2049.
evidence.location: INT. GATE LAB - 2049 - AFTER THE JUMP

revisions.script:
[scene]INT. FARMHOUSE - 1988 - AFTER THE ARRIVAL
[action]The fixed-timeline rules are written in Elder Lena's journal: THE GATE IS ONE-WAY FROM 2048 TO 1988. A TRAVELER'S PERSONAL LIFE CONTINUES FORWARD WHEN CALENDAR TIME MOVES BACKWARD. DIFFERENT-AGE VERSIONS MAY COEXIST.
[action]Elder Lena Ortiz, age seventy-two, holds the hand of twelve-year-old Lena Ortiz. They share the same crescent scar.
[action]Elder Lena dies at 3:14 a.m. The coroner records her wrist serial: L-2048-77. Twelve-year-old Lena remains alive.
[scene]INT. GATE LAB - 2048 - BEFORE THE ARRIVAL
[action]Sixty years later in young Lena's personal life, Lena is now seventy-two and bears the same crescent scar and wrist serial L-2048-77.
[action]She enters the one-way gate to 1988, beginning the journey that ends at the farmhouse.
